# W3C
> The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) develops open web standards, guidelines, and supporting resources for accessibility, internationalization, privacy, security, and interoperability.

W3C publishes technical reports, specifications, reviews, group information, policies, and participation resources that help organizations and individuals build a web that works across platforms, languages, and communities.

## Standards and Specifications
- [Web Standards](https://www.w3.org/standards/): Entry point for W3C standards, drafts, groups, and standards development resources.
- [About W3C Web Standards](https://www.w3.org/standards/about/): Explains how W3C standards are developed, reviewed, and maintained.
- [W3C Standards and Drafts](https://www.w3.org/TR/): Index of W3C Technical Reports, Recommendations, Notes, and working drafts.
- [Types of Documents W3C Publishes](https://www.w3.org/standards/types/): Overview of specification maturity levels and publication document types.
- [Reviews and Public Feedback](https://www.w3.org/standards/review/): Information on reviewing specifications and submitting public comments.
- [Translations of W3C Standards and Drafts](https://www.w3.org/translations/): Community translations of specifications and related technical documents.

## Groups and Governance
- [W3C Groups](https://www.w3.org/groups/): Directory of working groups, interest groups, community groups, and business groups.
- [Technical Architecture Group (TAG)](https://www.w3.org/groups/other/tag/): Architectural guidance and design review group for the web platform.
- [Liaisons](https://www.w3.org/liaisons/): Relationships and coordination with external standards bodies and organizations.
- [About W3C](https://www.w3.org/about/): Overview of W3C mission, structure, leadership, and organizational information.
- [Corporation](https://www.w3.org/about/corporation/): Information about the W3C legal entity and corporate structure.
- [Contact](https://www.w3.org/contact/): Contact information for W3C teams, offices, and inquiries.

## Participation and Membership
- [Get Involved](https://www.w3.org/get-involved/): Ways for developers, organizations, and communities to participate in W3C work.
- [Promote Web Standards](https://www.w3.org/get-involved/promote/): Resources for advocating and sharing adoption of open web standards.
- [Browse Our Work by Industry](https://www.w3.org/ecosystems/): Explore W3C work organized by industry sectors and ecosystems.
- [Become a Member](https://www.w3.org/membership/): Membership benefits, participation model, and joining information for organizations.
- [Support Us](https://www.w3.org/support-us/): Donation and support options for sustaining W3C’s mission.
- [Help](https://www.w3.org/help/): General help resources for navigating W3C services and information.

## Accessibility
- [Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/): W3C accessibility standards, guidelines, and educational resources for inclusive web experiences.
- [WAI Guidelines and Standards](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/): Central hub for WCAG, ATAG, UAAG, and related accessibility standards.
- [WCAG Overview](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/wcag/): Overview of Web Content Accessibility Guidelines and supporting materials.
- [ARIA Overview](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/aria/): Specifications and guidance for accessible rich internet applications.
- [Accessibility Fundamentals](https://www.w3.org/WAI/fundamentals/): Introductory resources explaining accessibility principles and business value.
- [WAI Tutorials](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/): Practical tutorials for implementing accessible web design and development patterns.

## Internationalization and Language Support
- [Internationalization Activity](https://www.w3.org/International/): W3C resources for multilingual web design and language enablement.
- [Internationalization Techniques](https://www.w3.org/International/techniques/): Authoring and implementation techniques for internationalized web content.
- [Internationalization Checker](https://www.w3.org/International/its/): Tools and resources related to internationalization support and data.
- [Character Model](https://www.w3.org/International/core/): Core internationalization architecture and character handling resources.
- [Language Enablement](https://www.w3.org/International/projects/): Projects and activities supporting scripts, languages, and locale requirements.

## Security, Privacy, and Architecture
- [Privacy](https://www.w3.org/privacy/): Privacy-related work, principles, and review resources across W3C specifications.
- [Security](https://www.w3.org/security/): Security-related standards work, guidance, and coordination resources.
- [Technical Architecture Group Findings](https://www.w3.org/2001/tag/doc/): TAG findings, design principles, and architectural guidance documents.
- [Ethical Web Principles](https://www.w3.org/2001/tag/doc/ethical-web-principles/): TAG guidance on ethical considerations in web platform design.
- [Design Principles](https://www.w3.org/TR/design-principles/): Cross-cutting principles for designing consistent and interoperable web platform features.

## Developer and Technical Resources
- [Validators and Tools](https://www.w3.org/developers/tools/): Developer-facing tools and validators for checking standards compliance.
- [Markup Validation Service](https://validator.w3.org/): Validate HTML and related markup against W3C specifications.
- [CSS Validation Service](https://jigsaw.w3.org/css-validator/): Validate CSS stylesheets for syntax and standards conformance.
- [Nu Html Checker](https://validator.w3.org/nu/): Modern HTML checker for documents, snippets, and URLs.
- [Web Platform Tests](https://wpt.fyi/): Cross-browser test results and infrastructure for web platform interoperability.
- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/w3c/): Source repositories, specifications, and issue trackers maintained by W3C groups.

## News and Communications
- [News and Events](https://www.w3.org/news-events/): W3C announcements, events, talks, and organizational updates.
- [News](https://www.w3.org/news/): Latest W3C news, press releases, and standards-related announcements.
- [Blog](https://www.w3.org/blog/): Posts from W3C staff and contributors on standards and web topics.
- [Events](https://www.w3.org/events/): Calendar of meetings, workshops, conferences, and community events.
- [Press and Media](https://www.w3.org/press-releases/): Official press releases and media-facing announcements from W3C.
- [Translations](https://www.w3.org/translations/): Localized versions of selected W3C standards and public materials.

## Policies and Legal
- [Legal and Policies](https://www.w3.org/policies/): Central hub for legal policies, process references, and governance documents.
- [Document License](https://www.w3.org/copyright/document-license/): Permissive license terms for W3C documents and publications.
- [Disclaimers](https://www.w3.org/policies/#disclaimers): Liability and disclaimer statements applicable to W3C materials.
- [Trademarks](https://www.w3.org/policies/#trademarks): Trademark policy and usage information for W3C names and marks.
- [Patent Policy](https://www.w3.org/policies/patent-policy/): Patent commitments and licensing framework for W3C Recommendations.
- [Process Document](https://www.w3.org/policies/process/): Rules and procedures governing W3C standards development.

## Multilingual and Regional Access
- [Japanese Website](https://www.w3.org/ja/): Japanese-language homepage and selected W3C resources.
- [Chinese Website](https://www.w3.org/zh-hans/): Simplified Chinese homepage and localized W3C materials.
- [Home](https://www.w3.org/): Main English-language homepage for W3C resources and updates.
- [System Status](https://status.w3.org/): Operational status information for W3C services and infrastructure.
